errors.message: Five Blueprint reusable-component scripts are not attached to their declared use-site nodes.
Blueprint declares seven pressed connections; the final scene has four, omitting all decision choice buttons.
Decision selection is pass; evidence drag/drop returns strings; required long-press/cancel/feedback paths are not implemented.
Grade thresholds and scoring branches conflict with approved source values.
Interview, evidence review, decision selection, and decision-button paths lack required connections, preventing a full session.
No CaseData, EvidenceData, VisitorData, or DecisionRule content resources are present.
